$Comment: Pieces of gear a Disenchanting Table took apart, rung 9 and the top of the disenchanting_unmade ladder. STATION_INPUT counts a stack the moment a station consumes it; the blank Target matches every item, so any piece of gear counts and nothing else can reach a table. Qualifier 'Disenchanting_Table' with QualifierMatchMode PREFIX counts BOTH tables (the greater table's station id starts with the lesser's); a qualifier left out would count the same item at the Sawmill too, so every disenchanting count names it. Announced to the server. Its Claim is XP and a long personal Enchanting boost token (Enchanting has no token item to hand over); the earned grimoire is paid by Orrin's own questline rather than here, so this rung stays a pure ladder top. Retune the whole ladder by editing each rung's Amount and nothing in a language file.
Name: Disenchanting_Unmade_T9
